Windows neden \"tanınmayan uygulama\" uy: Why does Windows warn about an "unrecognized app"?
Kurulum dosyasının henüz dijital imzası: The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen shows a warning. Click "More info", then "Run anyway". To verify the file, compare its SHA-256 checksum with the one on the release page. <a class="textlink" href="/docs/sorun-giderme/" >Troubleshooting</a >.
<code>%LOCALAPPDATA%\\seowatcher</code>: In the %LOCALAPPDATA%\seowatcher folder, which holds the database, your encrypted Google credentials and the logs. Uninstalling the app leaves the folder in place. To back up, copy the folder.
Neden Google'da bir erişim anahtarı oluş: Why do I need to create a Google Cloud credential?
seowatcher bir bulut hizmeti değildir. B: seowatcher is not a cloud service. It runs on your computer and connects to Google directly, so Google needs to know which Cloud project the requests come from. You set this up once, and the app shows each step.
Sayılar Search Console'dakiyle aynı mı?: Are the numbers the same as in Search Console?
Sayılar aynı kaynaktan gelir ama toplaml: The numbers come from the same source, but some totals can differ. Google reports data about three days late and hides very rare queries. The app shows page totals and the site total separately; a difference between them is expected.
Uygulamayı internete açmam gerekir mi?: Do I need to make the app reachable from the internet?
Hayır. Uygulama yalnızca kendi bilgisaya: No. The app is reachable only from your own computer. It reads Search Console and Analytics data from Google, and during an audit it crawls only the site you are auditing.
